notes.glasses: No tinted glasses or sunglasses. Clear prescription glasses allowed only if no glare, reflection, or frame covering eyes.
notes.smile: Neutral expression, mouth closed, no grinning or smiling.
notes.ears: Hair tucked back if covering face; eyes must be clearly visible.
notes.shadows: No shadows on face or background. Clear contrast between subject and background.
notes.babyRules: Children aged 1 to 5 do not need a neutral expression. Babies under 1 do not need eyes open. No hands, dummies, or toys.
